Hadith.4902 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever desires longevity, though there is no permanence, should have an early breakfast, wear well-made shoes, wear a light cloak, and reduce intimacy with women."
It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), what is meant by wearing a light cloak?"
Imam (as) replied: "It means having little debt."
